assumptions: JWT exp is checked locally; backend serviceExpirationMinutes can impose an earlier expiration.
POST like and message endpoints return HTTP 201 on success.
Each account starts with no chat rooms. It has reciprocal PENDING likes from recommendation ranks 1-4 and 13-15; ranks 1-4 create the four rooms when the account sends likes.

One iteration is one ten-minute user session: onboarding and active-batch reads, two recommendation pages, an initial room-list read, 12 likes, 15 profile reads, a second room-list read, and 15 messages.
PROFILE_DETAIL_PATH_TEMPLATE must be set to the confirmed other-user profile endpoint; the route is not guessed.
Exactly four new match rooms require reciprocal PENDING likes to be pre-seeded for four of the first twelve recommendation candidates per account.
PERFORMANCE_P95_MS defaults to 500ms as a provisional criterion, not an official SLO.
Recovery uses relative change from step1/hold; with a zero baseline, only a zero candidate is within tolerance.
Test data provisioning and cleanup are operator responsibilities; this script does not reset server state.
